items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This was one of the greatest producers I've ever seen.

ctx.x: I said, "Well, I'm really not qualified for that, you know, because I didn't have any degree in music or nothing like that. I'm just writing from the school of hard knocks, you know." And, anyway, so, then, after that, when Earl came back, and then went back out on the tour is when this accident happened. And, then, I joined the band.
And, then, of course, we came back in the Grand Terrace and there was a guy producing the shows named Percy Venable.
